hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the template K(n)*X(n) by specializing the parameter X to a(n) or b(n); both resulting terms retain the shared kernel K(n).
required_assumptions: K(n), a(n), and b(n) are defined for the index n.
hypotheses.rationale: The two additive terms are structurally identical up to the function multiplied by K(n), so they are instances of one parameterized product with a repeated kernel K(n).
